notes: This materializes deterministic public coefficient, incidence, and diagonal seeds for each row.
The generated tilt has exactly three nonzero row entries per tilt column and is combined with Cauchy guard/base blocks over the row's prime field.

Compressed view rows now report route diagnostics: support-covered rows need a concrete hitting-set certificate, while lossy-budget rows report whether the cheap viewed-noise and viewed-separation proxies are already satisfied.
The validator still rejects non-full views with view_reduction_certificate_missing until the corresponding Lean certificate or proof-carrying external evidence is supplied.
Passing rows should still be treated as candidates for deeper bounded dual-witness search and estimator work, not as deployed parameters.
